commits.subject: Flush HTTP/2 tunnel data to the local TCP writer (#62186)
commits.reason: Deliver the first server bytes immediately through a buffered TCP writer so an interactive peer can respond while the connection stays open.
evidence: Reviewed the two-file parent-to-commit patch, SHA-256 129fc7ca3c1f3592b4f8f4effb5381d247c8fec807452f5d0ba9ef5ff2b27ac0.

The receive loop flushes each write before returning HTTP/2 flow-control capacity. The upstream test waits for a server greeting before uploading through a buffered writer and retains its denied-response case.
commits.revisit: Run the interactive and refused HTTP/2 relay cases on the integrated source.
